name: Shanghai Stock Exchange
note: 2010-2024 sourced from exchange_calendars only (backfill; not independently verified). 2025-2026: exchange_calendars (no exchange publications). 2027: the State Council's 2027 holiday notice (国办发明电〔2026〕10号, published 2026-11-05 via Xinhua); SSE's own 2027 closure notice was not found, and mainland exchanges close on the notice's holidays and on weekends (make-up Saturdays/Sundays are not trading days). pandas_market_calendars has no XSHG holidays for 2027 and shows all 18 closures as open (contradicted_by). 2028-2029: not covered by exchange_calendars, which records XSHG holidays to 2026 only; the registry's dates are predictions until each year's State Council notice appears (normally early November of the year before). CI cannot reach the exchange's own page. Rechecked 2026-11-19 (4c-R1): 2027-05-04 and 2027-05-05 were missing (the notice gives Labour Day as 1-5 May 2027) and are added; the 2027 entries had cited sse.com.cn although they were written in September 2026, before any 2027 schedule existed (sse.com.cn could not be reached to see whether it lists 2027 now), and now cite the notice. Hours: 09:30-15:00 with the 11:30-13:00 lunch_break session. No half days: Chinese exchanges close for whole days only. 2020 Spring Festival extension (2020-01-31 closed, reopening 2020-02-03) is present. 2010-2024 matches exchange_calendars (0 disagreements).
